title: Finite subalgebras realizing a prescribed principal-open embedding
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring with identity, and let $Q\hookrightarrow\operatorname{Spec}R$ be an open immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-open-immersion]. Assume $Q$ is of finite type over $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Fix a finite family $h_1,\ldots,h_m\in R$ such that the image of $Q$ is $\bigcup_{l=1}^m D_R(h_l)$, where $D_R(h)=\{\mathfrak p:h\notin\mathfrak p\}$. For every finite subset $E\subset R$ there is a subring $A\subset R$, generated by finitely many elements over the image of $\mathbf Z$, containing $E$ and every $h_l$, such that each natural map $A_{h_l}\to R_{h_l}$ is an isomorphism [def-weil-ring-localization-away]. The induced map $Q\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is an open immersion with image exactly $\bigcup_lD_A(h_l)$, and it is the composite $Q\hookrightarrow\operatorname{Spec}R\to\operatorname{Spec}A$. The empty family and the zero ring are allowed.

source.place: Tag 01Z7 (lemma-quasi-affine-finite-type-over-Z), proof: choose generators of R_{h_l}, clear their denominators, and include optionally finitely many additional elements. The statement retains the chosen h_l and the resulting localization identifications.

proof.text: Write $Q_l=D_R(h_l)$, regarded as an open subscheme of $Q$. By [lem-weil-pbc-principal-localization-open-immersion], $Q_l=\operatorname{Spec}R_{h_l}$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-lft-affine-pairs] to the structure morphism $Q\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$, the affine open $Q_l$ of its source, and the whole affine target. The finite-type hypothesis implies locally finite type, so each $R_{h_l}$ is a finitely generated $\mathbf Z$-algebra. Choose a finite set of algebra generators $x_{lj}$.

source.place: Tag 01Z7 (lemma-quasi-affine-finite-type-over-Z), proof, including the omitted details

proof.text: By the fraction description in [def-weil-ring-localization-away], write each $x_{lj}=r_{lj}/h_l^{n_{lj}}$ with $r_{lj}\in R$. Let $A$ be the unital subring of $R$ generated by $E$, all the $h_l$, and all the $r_{lj}$. This is a finite set, so $A$ is generated by finitely many elements over the image of $\mathbf Z$ and contains all the prescribed elements. For every $l$, the image of $A_{h_l}\to R_{h_l}$ contains $r_{lj}/h_l^{n_{lj}}=x_{lj}$ and all integer constants. Since the $x_{lj}$ generate the whole target algebra, this map is surjective.

source.place: Tag 01Z7 (lemma-quasi-affine-finite-type-over-Z), proof, including the omitted details

proof.text: The same map is injective even when $h_l$ is a zero divisor. Indeed, if $a/h_l^n$ maps to zero in $R_{h_l}$, the fraction equality of [def-weil-ring-localization-away] gives $h_l^ka=0$ in $R$ for some $k$. Both factors lie in the subring $A$, so the same equality holds in $A$, and hence $a/h_l^n=0$ in $A_{h_l}$. Thus each natural map $\alpha_l:A_{h_l}\to R_{h_l}$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 01Z7 (lemma-quasi-affine-finite-type-over-Z), proof, including the omitted details

proof.text: Let $g:Q\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be the stated composite, and put $U=\bigcup_lD_A(h_l)$. By functoriality of Spec and the principal-localization description [def-weil-affine-spectrum, lem-weil-pbc-principal-localization-open-immersion], $g|_{Q_l}$ is the isomorphism $\operatorname{Spec}\alpha_l:Q_l\to D_A(h_l)$ followed by the open inclusion. Also $g^{-1}D_A(h_l)=Q_l$: on points a prime of $R$ contracts to a prime containing $h_l$ exactly when the original prime contains $h_l$. Consequently $g$ takes values in $U$. Let $b_l:D_A(h_l)\to Q$ be the inverse of this isomorphism followed by $Q_l\hookrightarrow Q$. On $D_A(h_l)\cap D_A(h_t)$, the image of $b_l$ lies in $Q_t$, since $g b_l$ is the identity and $g^{-1}D_A(h_t)=Q_t$. There $g|_{Q_t}$ is an isomorphism; both $b_l$ and $b_t$ are its inverse, so they agree. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-morphism-gluing] to glue the $b_l$ to $b:U\to Q$. On the displayed covers $gb$ and $bg$ are identities; uniqueness in that same gluing statement gives identities globally. Thus $Q\simeq U$, and the definition of open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] proves the claimed image and factorization.

source.place: Tag 01Z7 (lemma-quasi-affine-finite-type-over-Z), proof, including the omitted details

proof.text: If $m=0$, the given image is empty, hence $Q$ is empty; take the unital subring generated by $E$, and the empty scheme is isomorphic to the empty open of its spectrum. If $R$ is the zero ring, $A=R$ is finitely generated over the image of $\mathbf Z$, every localization is the zero ring, and both spectra and $Q$ are empty. Nilpotent $h_l$ cause no exception: their principal opens are empty and the fraction calculation above makes both localized rings zero.
